name: Offline injection contract
role: Defines workload discovery, preview, generated trainer resources, and reversible offline transformation

subject: Helm post-rendering and GitOps
why: Image defaults are absent from rendered manifests and live resource deletion belongs to the deployment reconciler

title: chose offline transformation with explicit trainer mode over a webhook and inferred mode

alternative: Admission webhook and automatic probe or framework inference — rejected: adds reconciliation duties and can infer unsafe trainer behavior
